essayTitle: A Night of Music to Remember
source: SPM 2026 Trial · Kelantan · English Paper 2 · Part 3 Q5 · Review, 200–250 words
paragraphs: Have you ever felt music so powerful that it gave you goosebumps? Last month, I attended a live performance that did exactly that, and I would like to share my experience.

The performer was the Malaysian Philharmonic Orchestra. It was an orchestral concert held at Dewan Filharmonik Petronas in Kuala Lumpur. The programme featured classical masterpieces as well as beloved Malaysian folk songs arranged for the orchestra.

I thoroughly enjoyed the performance because the musicians played with remarkable precision and passion. Every instrument blended seamlessly, creating a rich and powerful sound. Furthermore, the medley of Malaysian folk songs touched my heart. Hearing familiar tunes such as "Rasa Sayang" played by a full orchestra filled me with a deep sense of pride.

Moreover, the atmosphere in the concert hall was simply magical. The elegant hall had excellent acoustics, so even the softest notes could be heard clearly. The audience sat in pin-drop silence throughout each piece. When the final piece ended, the audience rose to their feet and gave a standing ovation.
In a nutshell, it was an unforgettable evening that I would recommend to anyone. Even if you are not a fan of classical music, this experience may change your mind.
